question_summary: Unforeseen existing electrical conduit conflicts with new duct routing at Electrical Closet 2A; request direction/approval for revised routing.
proposed_solution: Approve the attached/revised conduit rerouting sketch to clear the new duct at Electrical Closet 2A.
